appearance.label: Appearance
appearance.seeThemes: For theme, background and customization, see the Themes tab.

language.label: Language
language.description: Display language for the Terax interface.

showHidden.title: Show hidden files
showHidden.description: Include dot-prefixed files and folders (.env, .gitignore, .config) in the file explorer and search.

gitDecorations.title: Git decorations
gitDecorations.description: Tint changed files and dim gitignored entries in the file explorer.

showUndoCommit.title: Show Undo Commit
showUndoCommit.description: Show an action on the latest commit that moves HEAD to its parent and keeps the changes staged.

webgl.title: Use WebGL renderer
webgl.tooltip: xterm's WebGL renderer caches glyphs in a GPU texture atlas. On some macOS setups (especially with Nerd Fonts), the atlas corrupts and terminal text becomes unreadable. Turn this off as a fallback - performance dips slightly, but text renders correctly via the DOM renderer.
webgl.description: Hardware-accelerated rendering. Turn off if text shows corruption or blank tiles.

cursorBlink.title: Cursor blinking
cursorBlink.description: Blink the terminal cursor. Off by default for lower idle CPU, matching VS Code and the macOS terminal.

smartCopyPaste.title: Smart copy and paste
smartCopyPaste.description: When enabled, Ctrl+C copies selected text and otherwise interrupts; Ctrl+V pastes. Ctrl+Shift+C and Ctrl+Shift+V always remain available.

fontFamily.title: Font family
fontFamily.description: Nerd Font name for icons (e.g. "CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font Mono"). Leave blank to auto-detect.

shell.title: Integrated terminal shell
shell.descriptionNonIntegrated: Command blocks and directory tracking are unavailable for this shell.
shell.descriptionWsl: Shell for the integrated terminal. WSL spaces use the distro login shell. Existing tabs keep their shell.
shell.descriptionDefault: Shell for new terminal tabs. Existing tabs keep their shell.

workspaceEnv.title: Workspace environment
workspaceEnv.description: Where new spaces run, terminal and AI agent alike: Windows or a WSL distro. Existing spaces keep theirs; switch any from the status bar.

letterSpacing.title: Letter spacing
letterSpacing.description: Extra horizontal space between characters (px). Use negative values to tighten Nerd Fonts.

scrollback.title: Scrollback
scrollback.description: Lines of history kept per terminal. Higher uses more RAM (~3 KB / line).

notifications.title: Agent alerts
notifications.description: Alert when built-in or terminal agents need attention. Turning this off keeps bell history and terminal notification integrations.

test.notificationBody: If you can see this message, the system notification was displayed successfully.

hint.idle: Send a system notification two seconds after permission is granted; does not test agent integrations
hint.preparing: Checking or requesting system notification permission
hint.waiting: Switch to another app to verify native delivery
hint.requested: Notification requested; confirm whether the system displayed it
hint.denied: Notifications are disabled by the system
hint.failed: Terax could not request a native notification

launchAtLogin.title: Launch at login
launchAtLogin.description: Open Terax automatically when you sign in.

restoreWindow.title: Restore window position & size
restoreWindow.description: Reopen the main window where you left it. Applies on next launch.

workspaceWindows.title: Workspace windows
workspaceWindows.description: Single window reuses one window per Local, WSL, or SSH environment. Multiple windows also enables copying pages to temporary windows.

fileAssociations.title: File associations
fileAssociations.description: Add Open with Terax for files and folders, including multi-file selections. This does not change default apps.

header.title: Editor
header.description: Editing behavior, saving, and language servers.

vimMode.title: Vim mode
vimMode.description: Enable Vim keybindings in the code editor.

wordWrap.title: Word wrap
wordWrap.description: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling horizontally.

diffView.title: Git diff view
diffView.description: Show Git diffs inline or side by side.

autoSave.title: Auto save
autoSave.description: Automatically save files after a delay when changes are detected.

autoSaveDelay.title: Auto save delay
autoSaveDelay.description: Delay before unsaved changes are saved automatically.

formatOnSave.title: Format on save
formatOnSave.description: Format the file on explicit save (Cmd+S / :w) with the formatter below.

formatter.title: Formatter
formatter.description: Language server formats the buffer before writing; Biome and Prettier run on the saved file from your PATH.

customCommand.title: Custom command
customCommand.description: Runs on the saved file; {file} is replaced with the quoted path (appended when omitted).

languageOverrides.title: Language overrides
languageOverrides.description: Use a different formatter for specific languages (e.g. Ruff for Python).

editorTheme.label: Editor theme
editorTheme.description: Syntax colors for the code editor. Auto follows the app theme.

background.label: Background
background.dropHint: Drop an image here or pick one. Stored locally; doesn't affect the default look until set.

resetDialog.title: Reset app shortcuts?
resetDialog.description: This will restore all in-app shortcuts to their defaults. System-wide screenshot shortcuts are unchanged. This action cannot be undone.

header.title: Models
header.description: Connect the providers you use. Keys live in your OS keychain and are used only by Terax.

parameters.label: Model configuration
parameters.description: Controls when Terax compacts Agent history and how context usage is calculated. It does not limit model output.

lmstudio.description: Run GGUF models via LM Studio's HTTP server (enable it from the Developer tab).

mlx.description: Apple silicon inference via mlx_lm.server (pip install mlx-lm).

ollama.description: Local models via Ollama's built-in OpenAI-compatible API.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.descOpenai: Uses your official OpenAI API key and the Whisper model for transcription.
voice.descGroq: Uses your official Groq API key and Groq's Whisper endpoint for transcription.
voice.descWhispercpp: Connects to a local Whisper.cpp server for fully offline transcription.

providers.label: Providers
providers.emptyHint: Click "Add provider" to connect a cloud or local model source.

card.name: Name
card.optionalKeyPlaceholder: Optional - leave empty for unauthenticated endpoints

catalog.searchOrEnter: Search or enter a model ID
catalog.configureFirst: Configure the endpoint and API key to discover models. You can still add one manually.
catalog.empty: No matching models returned. You can add an ID manually.
catalog.openToLoad: Open the picker to discover models.

error.network: Could not reach the provider. You can still add a model manually.

header.title: Agents
header.description: Manage agent instructions, default workspace files, and available tools.

customInstructions.label: Global instructions
customInstructions.placeholder: e.g. Always reply in concise bullet points. Prefer pnpm over npm. My machine is an M-series Mac.

snippets.label: Snippets
snippets.description: Reusable instructions you can drop into any prompt with #handle.
snippets.empty: No snippets yet. Create one and insert it with #handle in the AI input.

agentDialog.name: Name
agentDialog.descriptionPlaceholder: One line, shown in the agent picker
agentDialog.toolsDescription: Select tools individually. write_file and apply_patch require read_file; deselecting read_file also deselects both editing tools. Tool permissions still apply.
agentDialog.nextTurn: Saved changes apply to the next turn in new and existing conversations. A running turn keeps its current configuration.
agentDialog.unavailable: Unavailable for this agent or conversation.
agentDialog.saveFailed: Could not save the agent. Your edits have been kept.

delete.title: Delete custom agent?
delete.description: Deleting “{{name}}” permanently deletes the agent and its {{count}} conversations across all workspaces. This cannot be undone.
delete.running: Stop all conversations currently running with this agent before deleting it.
delete.failed: The custom agent could not be deleted.
delete.countFailed: The agent's conversations could not be counted.

snippetDialog.name: Name
snippetDialog.descriptionPlaceholder: One line - shown in the # picker
snippetDialog.contentPlaceholder: Inserted into the prompt as a <snippet> block when you use #handle.
snippetDialog.errFormat: Lowercase letters, digits, and dashes only.

prompt.title: Prompt configuration
prompt.description: Sections appear in the order sent to the model. Runtime sections depend on the conversation.
prompt.environmentRuntime: Generated at runtime from the conversation workspace, operating system, default shell, and fixed working directory.
prompt.workspaceRuntime: Separate relative file paths with English commas, e.g. AGENTS.md, docs/agent.md. Files load in order relative to the conversation working directory. Missing files are silently skipped. Leave empty to load none. Absolute paths, parent traversal, wildcards, and commas in file names are not supported.
prompt.invalidFiles: Use relative file paths within the workspace, without wildcards.
prompt.subagent: Subagent role appended after the above sections (read-only)

toolDescriptions.read_file: Read text files with line ranges.
toolDescriptions.write_file: Create or rewrite a complete text file.
toolDescriptions.file_operation: Move, copy, delete files, or create directories.
toolDescriptions.shell_process: Read output, send input, or stop a managed process.
toolDescriptions.get_terminal_output: Read the active non-private terminal scrollback.
toolDescriptions.run_subagent: Delegate a task to a subagent.
toolDescriptions.message: Send text and attachments to the current channel.

network.title: Network and proxy
network.description: Configure one shared proxy, then choose its use for each connection. Built-in requests connect directly by default.
network.missing: Configure the shared proxy in Settings > General > Network and proxy. Requests will fail until it is configured.
network.urlHint: Supports HTTP, HTTPS and SOCKS5. Include a username in the URL when authentication is required, for example http://user@127.0.0.1:7890. Enter the password separately.
network.passwordHint: Leave empty to keep the saved password
network.saved: Saved. Changes apply to subsequent requests.
network.saveError: Unable to load or save network settings. Check the proxy URL and credentials, then try again.
network.scope: Applies to Terax built-in requests. Terminal commands, external agents, Git processes, web previews and Python data sources manage their own networking. Proxy failures never fall back to a direct connection.
network.sshHint: Controls the connection to this SSH server. Changes apply on the next connection, not to programs running on the server.
